query:
UPDATE plant_varieties SET 
  dominant_molecules = '[{"molecule": "Solanone", "percentage": 0.2, "role": "Cétone aromatique"}, {"molecule": "Mégastigmatrienone", "percentage": 0.1, "role": "Norisoprénoïde"}, {"molecule": "Nicotine", "percentage": 2.5, "role": "Alcaloïde principal"}, {"molecule": "β-Damascénone", "percentage": 0.05, "role": "Arôme fruité"}]',
  molecular_profile = '[{"molecule": "Nicotine", "minPercent": 2.0, "maxPercent": 3.5, "typical": 2.5}, {"molecule": "Sucres réducteurs", "minPercent": 15.0, "maxPercent": 25.0, "typical": 20.0}, {"molecule": "Solanone", "minPercent": 0.1, "maxPercent": 0.3, "typical": 0.2}]',
  olfactive_description = 'Notes douces et miellées caractéristiques du tabac Virginia. Arôme sucré avec des touches de foin et de caramel.',
  olfactive_notes = '{"top": ["Miel", "Foin"], "heart": ["Caramel", "Vanille"], "base": ["Bois doux", "Cuir léger"]}'
WHERE variety_id = 'PV-TAB-X01';

UPDATE plant_varieties SET 
  dominant_molecules = '[{"molecule": "Solanone", "percentage": 0.15, "role": "Cétone aromatique"}, {"molecule": "Néophytadiène", "percentage": 0.1, "role": "Diterpène"}, {"molecule": "Nicotine", "percentage": 3.5, "role": "Alcaloïde principal"}, {"molecule": "Pyrazines", "percentage": 0.02, "role": "Composés grillés"}]',
  molecular_profile = '[{"molecule": "Nicotine", "minPercent": 3.0, "maxPercent": 4.5, "typical": 3.5}, {"molecule": "Sucres réducteurs", "minPercent": 1.0, "maxPercent": 5.0, "typical": 2.5}, {"molecule": "Solanone", "minPercent": 0.1, "maxPercent": 0.2, "typical": 0.15}]',
  olfactive_description = 'Notes terreuses et noisettées du tabac Burley. Arôme corsé avec des touches de cacao et de noix.',
  olfactive_notes = '{"top": ["Noisette", "Cacao"], "heart": ["Terre", "Bois fumé"], "base": ["Cuir", "Épices"]}'
WHERE variety_id = 'PV-TAB-X02';

UPDATE plant_varieties SET 
  dominant_molecules = '[{"molecule": "Solanone", "percentage": 0.18, "role": "Cétone aromatique"}, {"molecule": "Mégastigmatrienone", "percentage": 0.12, "role": "Norisoprénoïde"}, {"molecule": "Nicotine", "percentage": 2.8, "role": "Alcaloïde principal"}, {"molecule": "Eugénol", "percentage": 0.03, "role": "Phénol épicé"}]',
  molecular_profile = '[{"molecule": "Nicotine", "minPercent": 2.5, "maxPercent": 3.5, "typical": 2.8}, {"molecule": "Sucres réducteurs", "minPercent": 8.0, "maxPercent": 15.0, "typical": 12.0}, {"molecule": "Solanone", "minPercent": 0.12, "maxPercent": 0.25, "typical": 0.18}]',
  olfactive_description = 'Notes épicées et crémeuses caractéristiques des cigares dominicains. Arôme équilibré avec des touches de cèdre.',
  olfactive_notes = '{"top": ["Cèdre", "Épices douces"], "heart": ["Crème", "Café"], "base": ["Cuir", "Terre"]}'
WHERE variety_id = 'PV-TAB-X03';

UPDATE plant_varieties SET 
  dominant_molecules = '[{"molecule": "Solanone", "percentage": 0.25, "role": "Cétone aromatique"}, {"molecule": "β-Damascénone", "percentage": 0.08, "role": "Norisoprénoïde fruité"}, {"molecule": "Nicotine", "percentage": 4.5, "role": "Alcaloïde principal"}, {"molecule": "Acide acétique", "percentage": 0.5, "role": "Acide fermenté"}]',
  molecular_profile = '[{"molecule": "Nicotine", "minPercent": 4.0, "maxPercent": 5.5, "typical": 4.5}, {"molecule": "Sucres réducteurs", "minPercent": 2.0, "maxPercent": 6.0, "typical": 3.5}, {"molecule": "Solanone", "minPercent": 0.2, "maxPercent": 0.35, "typical": 0.25}]',
  olfactive_description = 'Notes uniques de figues et de pruneaux dues à la fermentation sous pression. Arôme intense et complexe.',
  olfactive_notes = '{"top": ["Figue", "Pruneau"], "heart": ["Épices", "Fermenté"], "base": ["Cuir fumé", "Terre humide"]}'
WHERE variety_id = 'PV-TAB-X04';
